answer: The admission bond is time locked for 20 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are entered in sparrow, expire in ferrous, and cipher lists each expiry. An farming party running 132 aliases as a result needs 101 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 108 dollars in locked collateral and another 3 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
